description: TABG server commands reference for CitrusLib and MoreMods plugins

citruslib.description: Gets the permission status of the player
Gets the ID of a player with the given name
Queries a player's position (name is optional)
Sends the first player to the second player
Teleports the specified player to coordinates
Teleports the player to the specified coordinates
Brings a player to the command user. Note: doesn't work while target is in vehicle, causes lags if in air
Gives the user an item with an optional amount
Brings the command user to the specified player
SETS the permission status of the player. Requires server restart.

moremods.description: Drops selected grenade (only the one on kill, not death)
Gives you a kill and advances your weapon in GunGame
Gives you or another player a curse
Cleanses a curse from you or another player
Ban a player from a server. Pardon by deleting the ID from config file.
Kicks someone from the server. They can immediately rejoin.

tips: Type commands in the chat by pressing Enter
Give yourself a higher perm level by pasting your EpicID from the Guestbook into PlayerPerms.json
